message: A note in the README linking to a JSON example.

pr.title: A note in the README linking to a JSON example.
pr.body: More than once I've had to dig into the code to work out how the keys are formatted in the JSON resolver. This will hopefully save some time for others!

diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 356044b..ccbbf7d 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -469,6 +469,8 @@ eg.
 kong.Parse(&cli, kong.Configuration(kong.JSON, "/etc/myapp.json", "~/.myapp.json"))
 ```
 
+[See the tests](https://github.com/alecthomas/kong/blob/master/resolver_test.go#L103) for an example of how the JSON file is structured.
+
 ### `Resolver(...)` - support for default values from external sources
 
 Resolvers are Kong's extension point for providing default values from external sources. As an example, support for environment variables via the `env` tag is provided by a resolver. There's also a builtin resolver for JSON configuration files.

explanation.what: README の Configuration(...) 節に、JSON リゾルバの設定ファイル構造の実例として resolver_test.go への参照リンクを1行追加した。
explanation.why: PR本文の通り、JSON リゾルバがどのようなキー形式でファイルを読むのかコードを読まないと分からなかった経験から、テストコードへのリンクを README に足して同じ手間を他の利用者が繰り返さずに済むようにした。
